# AIFlowix

> AIFlowix is an India-based AI automation, intelligent agent development, and custom software engineering consultancy serving businesses in India, the US, the UK, Canada, Australia, the UAE, and globally.

## Core Services

- [AI Automation Services](https://aiflowix.in/ai-automation-services): Enterprise and mid-market AI workflow automation and process integration.
- [AI Agent Development](https://aiflowix.in/ai-agent-development): Custom autonomous AI agents for customer support, lead qualification, and internal ops.
- [Workflow Automation](https://aiflowix.in/workflow-automation-services): Multi-system integrations connecting CRMs, databases, and webhook pipelines.
- [Voice AI Agents](https://aiflowix.in/voice-ai-agents): Autonomous inbound voice receptionists and call answering.
- [AI Receptionist](https://aiflowix.in/ai-receptionist): 24/7 intelligent receptionist and calendar booking systems.
- [WhatsApp Automation](https://aiflowix.in/whatsapp-automation): Official WhatsApp Business API chatbots and customer engagement pipelines.
- [Custom Software Development](https://aiflowix.in/custom-software-development): Bespoke React, Node, and Python web applications and operations portals.
- [Web Development Services](https://aiflowix.in/web-development-services): High-performance B2B websites and web applications.
- [CRM Development & Automation](https://aiflowix.in/crm-development): Two-way synchronization across HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, and custom CRMs.

## Industry Solutions

- [Real Estate Automation](https://aiflowix.in/real-estate-automation): Instant lead qualification and portal webhook pipelines.
- [Dental Clinic Automation](https://aiflowix.in/dental-clinic-automation): Patient booking, confirmation, and schedule synchronization.
- [Recruitment Agency Automation](https://aiflowix.in/recruitment-agency-automation): Candidate screening and automated outreach.
- [Law Firm Automation](https://aiflowix.in/law-firm-automation): Client intake and document processing.
- [Healthcare Automation](https://aiflowix.in/healthcare-automation): Patient intake triage and calendar synchronization.
- [Logistics Automation](https://aiflowix.in/logistics-automation): Dispatch notifications and real-time shipment tracking.

## Interactive Tools & Audits

- [Free AI Audit](https://aiflowix.in/free-ai-audit): Free business workflow assessment and automation roadmap.
- [ROI Calculator](https://aiflowix.in/roi-calculator): Instant estimation of time and cost savings from business automation.
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://aiflowix.in/ai-readiness): 10-question evaluation of organizational AI readiness.
